# Camera Whiteboard

> Windows 11 x64 desktop whiteboard that overlays mouse-drawn diagrams on live webcam video and exposes a Media Foundation virtual camera. English interface. Local processing. No OBS dependency.

## Entry points
- [README](README.md): purpose, installation, source build, tests and packaging.
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): actual frame pipeline, paths and known boundaries.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): focused changes, behavioral testing and evidence requirements.
- [User guide](packaging/USER_GUIDE.md): installation and UI behavior.
- [Validation](validation/release-2026-10-27.md): current verification scope; historical notes may include Chinese.

## Code map
- ui/camera_whiteboard: Python/PySide6 drawing, capture, composition and publication.
- third_party/vcamsample/VCamSampleSource: active native C++ media source.
- packaging: PyInstaller configuration, install/uninstall and component licenses.
- scripts/export_release.py: clean source and application bundle export.
- tests/ui: test discovery root.

## Contracts
Outgoing video is 1280x720; the board sheet is 4:3. Panel position is independent of content mirroring. Hiding the sheet keeps video running. The native source must not depend on Python/Qt. Direct DLL tests are not remote meeting validation. Shared-frame snapshot consistency and camera reconnect recovery remain open work.
